parameters.query:
select
  u.id as upload_id,
  u.user_id,
  u.storage_path,
  u.file_name,
  u.file_sha256,
  u.extracted_text,
  coalesce(p.revision, 1) as base_profile_revision,
  coalesce(to_jsonb(p), '{}'::jsonb) as current_profile,
  coalesce(
    (select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name', s.name, 'level', ps.level))
     from public.profile_skills ps
     join public.skills s on s.id = ps.skill_id
     where ps.user_id = u.user_id),
    '[]'::jsonb
  ) as current_skills
from public.resume_uploads u
left join public.profiles p on p.user_id = u.user_id
where (u.id = $1::uuid or ($1::uuid is null and u.status in ('uploaded', 'validating', 'draft_ready')))
order by u.created_at desc
limit 1;

insert into public.profile_drafts (
  user_id,
  resume_upload_id,
  base_profile_revision,
  contract_version,
  proposed_fields,
  proposed_skills,
  missing_fields,
  status
)
values (
  $1::uuid,
  $2::uuid,
  $3::integer,
  $4::text,
  $5::jsonb,
  $6::jsonb,
  $7::jsonb,
  'draft_ready'
)
returning id as draft_id, user_id, resume_upload_id, status, created_at;

update public.resume_uploads
set status = 'draft_ready', updated_at = now()
where id = $1::uuid
returning id, status, updated_at;

parameters.content: ## Slice S5 Resume Processing Workflow\nExtracts academic facts, degree, graduation year, CGPA and detected skills with literal page evidence. Skill proficiency is strictly set to null for student confirmation. Raw file subject to Privacy D9 retention cleanup upon confirmation.
